verdict.rationale: monday.com documents its own GraphQL platform API, SDKs, webhook event subscriptions, and programmatic agent management, so substantial programmatic access exists. Nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates that the API matches everything the UI can do. Missing for 10: an explicit documented claim of API/UI feature parity, a coverage map of UI features exposed via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
